anchoring.note: Each confirmed proof shows the manifest digest existed before the block it names, as the calendar's upgraded proof has it. Run `ots verify` on the files in anchors/ to check that against Bitcoin yourself; this record does not. These counts are of the rows in anchors/index.jsonl as they stood when this file was written, which is before publication 49's own row: that row stamps the digest of the MANIFEST.json covering this file, so a count in here cannot include it without changing the digest it names. Publication 49's row is written as this publication is delivered and is in anchors/index.jsonl beside this file, so expect exactly one more row there than `attempted` says.
